basis: L8 has 34 existing negative rows; all 34 carry explicit classification codes that resolve to corresponding L4 classifications and L5 rules.
All 182 L9 rows lack expected_classification and code, so checker identity falls back to their IDs. L8 classification codes cannot match those ID keys.
32 L8 rows already have exact integration_case_ref values to a current L9 row; this reference does not override the checker key precedence. Two L8 rows have no exact current L9 target recorded.
Each of the seven function groups has matching L4/L5/L8 counts and a larger L9 count. Adding L8 rows to mimic L9 counts would lack L4/L5 rows and source-backed unique L8 classifications.

Changing L8 U-ID or classification key to mimic L9 would either violate retained U-ID/classification semantics or create L4/L5 key and tuple mismatches. The checker implementation or L9 representation must change to reconcile identity namespaces; neither is an L8-only action.

scope_boundary: Rows are represented by existing IDs, classifications, refs, and JSON pointers only; no expected payloads, fixtures, or L9 values are copied.
